name: slide-images
title_zh: 缺图就现找现画，还顺手把 Marp 指令写对
tagline_zh: 做课件卡在没图？它去翻梗图、截屏、画图表，Graphviz/matplotlib 都行。
tagline_en: Stuck on a slide with no visual? It hunts memes, screenshots, charts, or draws via Graphviz/matplotlib, then.
desc_en: Find or make an image for a slide - a meme, a screenshot, a chart, or a diagram (Graphviz, matplotlib) - and place it in the week's assets folder with the right Marp image directive. Use when a slide needs a visual, when the user asks for a meme, figure, diagram, chart, or picture, or when deck QA reports a missing image.
why_zh: 不是只给图，而是把「找图/生图 + 放对文件夹 + 写对 Marp 语法」打包成一条流水线。
why_en: It's not just an image finder—it chains sourcing, saving to the right folder, and emitting correct Marp syntax, even fixing.
limit_zh: 只认 Marp 幻灯片项目，且需要 week 目录结构已存在；不会自动安装 Graphviz/matplotlib。
limit_en: Only for Marp decks with an existing week/ folder; won't install Graphviz/matplotlib or vet image licenses; meme sources limited to publicly.
title_en: Find or draw slide visuals, then wire up Marp
